name: 洪媽益
objective:
本課程分為兩部分：（1）英文文法觀念的溫故知新，並引導學生將正確的文法觀念運用在閱讀與寫作上，學生可加強基本句型練習、句子改正及句型修正。相關討論包括直述句、引述句、句型變化與修飾;（2）英語修辭法：聽講溝通的有效原理原則。課堂討論主題包括：指稱、一致、倒裝等修辭觀念。修習本課後，學生對出現在相同邏輯意義語境中， 利用不同表達方式以凸顯各種語意的方式與內涵，當有更進一步的體認。
This course is divided into two parts: (a) The first part is designed for the students to  familiarize themselves with English grammatical framework in relation to reading and writing. A review of grammatical ideas at high level is reinforced by correcting sentence errors, and revising awkward usage of words or sentence structures. The main subjects include English sentence structures, verbal usages, conjunctions, and sequences. Related topics for class discussion cover direct and indirect speech, sentence transformation and modification of sentences; (b) The second half of the course focuses on English rhetoric--principles of effective written and spoken communication. Topics for class discussion include reference, coherence, reverse structures and some related rhetorical concepts. It is hoped that the students will know better the significance brought about by the variations of different expressions that occur in the similar linguistic contexts.

•	September 15: Overview
•	September 22: Tense and Aspect
•	September 29: Modality
•	October 6: Passives
•	October 13: Midterm exam
•	October 20: Overview
•	October 27: Articles
•	November 3: Reference
•	November 10: Relative clauses
•	November 17: Midterm exam
•	November 24: Overview (10-12nn); Prepositions and Phrasal verbs
•	December 1: Complementation
•	December 8: make-up class in the morning of November 24
•	December 15: Conditionals
•	December 22: Exam
END
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Each student will find one 500-word academic/journal article and one 500-word literary article, and make ten copies of both articles. One copy will be needed each class for guided activity.
Based on one grammatical feature (or the grammatical feature discussed), students will compare both articles and submit a one-page reflection on the similarities and differences in their usage in both articles.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Students will analyze the similarities and differences between both articles in terms of a chosen grammatical feature and offer implications/reflections on their observations.
A final paper consisting of one A4-sized page will be submitted to miguelntut@gmail.com.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          The final project will make up 20% of the final grade.
